coordinateSystem: Saved geometry millimetres: X across bench, Y bench length, Z up; source cut coordinates are millimetres along each parent stock.

displaySemantics.surplus: Surplus cuts stay in a separate output tray and never become installed members.
displaySemantics.residual: Residual stays attached to its parent stock ledger and remains visible as offcut, never as an installed piece.
displaySemantics.movement: Illustrates the saved source-to-target mapping, not a verified fabrication or safe assembly sequence.
displaySemantics.appearance: Any source texture is representative listing appearance; exact board surface registration is not established.
